description.zh: 需要查询的智能生产作业ID。从[提交智能生产作业](~~170216~~)的返回参数中获取。
description.en: The ID of the intelligent production job to query. Obtain it from the response parameters of [Submit an intelligent production job](~~170216~~).

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口的查询结果中，包含对应请求算法的处理结果。
- 若返回参数仅有RequestId和JobId，则需确认是否为智能生产作业。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
The query result of this API includes the processing result of the corresponding requested algorithm.

## QPS limit
The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user on this API is 100 requests per second. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to Rate Limiting, which may Impact your Business Data. Please invoke the API appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).
